owner_decision: 2026-11-23 Bilibili benchmark WP5-C (~/nalu_lab/bili_work/CHANGE_SPEC.md): 2-3 mood cues per episode, opt-in per series (craft_profile BILI_V1 + bgm_mood_cues: true). Each brief is one paid source (~8 credits) per series: sources are keyed by sha256(brief)[:16] and cached at <RUNTIME>/sources/<scope>/bgm/. Editing a brief = a new paid source for every series that uses that mood.

tender.brief: gentle, warm instrumental underscore for a tender short-drama moment: soft felt piano, light sustained strings and a quiet acoustic guitar, slow and intimate, sits under dialogue; no vocals, no lyrics, no drum hits

comic_bounce.brief: light, bouncy comedic instrumental underscore for a short drama: pizzicato strings, staccato woodwinds and a playful marimba, mid tempo, mischievous and cheerful, leaves room for dialogue; no vocals, no lyrics, no heavy drums

heartbreak.brief: melancholic, heartbroken instrumental underscore for a short drama: slow solo piano over low sustained cello and soft string pads, aching and restrained, sits under dialogue; no vocals, no lyrics, no drum hits

tension.brief: tense, suspenseful instrumental underscore for a short-drama confrontation: low pulsing synth bass, tremolo strings and a slow ticking pulse, steady build without a climax, stays under dialogue; no vocals, no lyrics, no loud drum hits

triumph.brief: confident, triumphant instrumental underscore for a short-drama payoff: rising strings, bold brass swells and a driving low percussion pulse, uplifting and decisive, controlled so dialogue stays clear; no vocals, no lyrics

mystery.brief: mysterious, intriguing instrumental underscore for a short drama: sparse celesta and harp notes over dark ambient pads and a soft bowed-metal texture, slow and curious, sits under dialogue; no vocals, no lyrics, no drum hits
